deviations.from: The handover asks each MISCON slot to name its misconception_entry on the item.
deviations.to: The misconception entry id is recorded in the item's provenance string (and in the marking guidance where useful), because the v0.2.0 learning-items schema forbids additional properties.
deviations.why: The schema's additionalProperties:false leaves no dedicated field; provenance keeps the entry machine-readable without breaking C-00.

deviations.from: Slot ITEM-9702-8-044-DEF sits on objective 8.1-02 (the stationary-wave experiments), where the obvious definition is 'stationary wave'.
deviations.to: The card defines resonance in the air-column experiment instead; the stationary-wave definition is carried by slot 045-DEF on objective 8.1-03, where it belongs.
deviations.why: Defining the same term twice would duplicate slot 045's prompt, and resonance is the term the air-column experiment actually turns on.
